retain.reason: High integrated mechanical/UI value; expensive to recreate.
Adequate for lightweight terminal/gateway role if exact acceptance tests pass.
Documented mature I/O is the principal donor value.
Retain intact and unmodified to avoid creating a new mains design boundary.

replace.reason: Old HDD/SSD condition is a high-variance failure source.

add.reason: Adds modern protected field/test I/O without modifying donor mains or motherboard.
Turns commodity/retired POS hardware into a repeatable test-console workflow.
Binds donor identity, sidecar identity, software image and functional checks.

reject_if: motherboard is not B91 approved revision
touch panel fails calibration or repeated cold-boot recognition
LCD has unacceptable defects for operator use
Ethernet or required USB ports fail
internal PSU shows physical damage, abnormal noise, odor, overheating or unstable output
